sources.title: Deepseek V4.1 Flash on a single MI350P - eliovp.com
sources.snippet: The model is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. Its original checkpoint occupies 475 GiB, far beyond this card's 144 GB of HBM. The result comes from changing how the model is stored and executed, rather than fitting the entire original model onto the card. Paiton is our framework for optimizing AI on AMD hardware.
